en.ask.basis.title: title only
en.ask.basis.title.why: This page was never fetched; the excerpt is inferred from its title.
en.ask.degraded.why: It either failed outright or returned something that could not be read as claims with citations. What follows is one sentence pulled out of each source, not a written answer.
en.ask.gaps.why: Reported by the retrieval step, in its own words.
en.ask.label: Question
en.ask.lede: Retrieves the pages that bear on a question, then asks the configured model to write claims from their text alone. Every claim carries the sources it was drawn from, so you can check it.
en.ask.mock.body: The server is running the mock provider, so this returns placeholder text rather than an answer. Point it at a chat model and restart. The button still works — this is what the mock output looks like.
en.ask.mock.title: No model is configured
en.ask.none.body: The retrieval step found nothing to read for this question. Try different words, or index more of the library.
en.ask.placeholder: What do you want answered out of what you saved?
en.ask.sources.lede: The pages the claims were written from. Excerpts come from the stored index, not from a fresh fetch.
en.ask.title: Ask the library
en.detail.basis.title: summarised from the title
en.detail.basis.title.why: The page body was never fetched, so this summary is a model's inference from the title and URL, not text read off the page. Run facetmark index with fetching on to replace it.
en.detail.sittings.lede: Saved in the same browsing session as this page.
en.detail.sittings.none: This page was not grouped into a session.
en.edge.anchor_sibling.why: Linked from the same page as a result above.
en.edge.same_domain.why: From the same site as a result above.
en.edge.semantic.why: Close in meaning to a result above.
en.edge.session.why: Saved in the same browsing session as a result above.
en.edge.supersession.why: Looks like a newer take on a result above.
en.empty.body: Try fewer words, or describe what you wanted the page for rather than what it was called.
en.empty.import.body: facetmark has no bookmarks yet. Import them from your browser, then build the index.
en.empty.import.title: Your library is empty
en.empty.index.body: {n} bookmarks are stored, but none of them have been indexed, so search has nothing to rank. This runs offline unless you configured a model.
en.empty.index.title: Nothing is indexed yet
en.empty.queue: {n} pages are still waiting to be fetched, so their text cannot be searched yet.
en.empty.title: Nothing in your library matches that yet
en.err.generic.title: The request failed
en.err.offline.body: This page is served by facetmark itself, so if you can read this the server was running a moment ago. It may have been stopped or restarted.
en.err.offline.title: The facetmark server is not answering
en.err.token.body: facetmark hands the token to pages loaded from this machine automatically. It could not this time — usually because the server is being reached through a proxy or a hostname rather than 127.0.0.1. Print the token and paste it here.
en.err.token.title: This page needs the pairing token
en.facet.intent.why: A question this page was saved to answer matched.
en.facet.lex_seg.why: A whole word in the title, folder or address matched.
en.facet.lex_tri.why: Part of a word matched, so partial and Chinese queries still find it.
en.library.lede: What facetmark has actually indexed. If a search came back empty, the answer is usually on this page.
en.library.title: Your library
en.mark.cold.why: Saved long ago, never opened, and something newer looks like it replaced it. Ranked lower, never deleted.
en.mark.linked.why: Reached through the link graph from a result above.
en.mode.A.why: The page's own text, as one vector. Nothing else.
en.mode.B.why: The content vector plus the two lexical facets, which match the words themselves. Not a wording-only mode — there is no wording-only mode.
en.mode.C.why: Content, remembered intent and both lexical facets, fused.
en.mode.D.why: Everything in C, plus a context pass over what you were reading and a walk out through the link graph. Slower, and needs a configured model to be worth it.
en.mode.E.why: Everything in D, then a reranker re-orders the fused list. The slowest rung; without a configured model it falls back to a cheap offline scorer.
en.mode.full.why: What /search uses when the caller asks for nothing in particular: the content vector, the link graph and a recency decay.
en.mode.label: Retrieval configuration
en.opts.expand.why: After ranking, pull in up to this many pages that were saved alongside the results. Set it to 0 to switch it off.
en.related.none: Nothing links to this page yet. Edges are built while indexing.
en.search.label: Search your library
en.search.title: Search your library
en.sessions.lede: Bookmarks saved close together in time, grouped by the gap between them. Reading order is often the only thing that still remembers why two pages belong together.
en.sessions.none.body: Sessions are built during indexing from the times bookmarks were saved. Lower the threshold, or index the library.
en.sessions.title: Sessions
en.settings.file.body: Saving writes this file, readable only by you. An exported environment variable still wins over anything in it, which is why some boxes above are read-only.
en.settings.file.title: Where this is written
en.settings.h.api_key: Stored on this machine. Only the first and last characters are shown.
en.settings.h.base_url: The endpoint, ending in /v1. Point it at a provider or at a local server.
en.settings.h.chat_model: Used to summarise pages while indexing, and to write syntheses.
en.settings.h.chat_model_fallbacks: Tried in order when the main model refuses. Comma separated.
en.settings.h.embed_backend: api uses the endpoint above. local runs a model on this machine and needs no key.
en.settings.h.embed_dim: Must match the model. Changing it invalidates every vector already stored.
en.settings.h.embed_model: Turns page text into the vectors two of the four facets search.
en.settings.h.enrich_concurrency: How many summaries are in flight at once. Providers rate-limit; this is the dial.
en.settings.h.fetch_concurrency: Higher is faster and ruder to the sites being read. Lower it if pages start failing.
en.settings.h.local_embed_path: Where the local embedding model lives on disk.
en.settings.h.privacy_excluded_domains: Never fetched and never sent to a model. Comma separated. Banking and webmail belong here.
en.settings.h.request_timeout: Seconds before one call to the model is given up on.
en.settings.job.cancelled: Stopped. Run it again to carry on from here.
en.settings.job.lede: Seven stages, in order. Fetching and summarising are the slow ones. You can leave this page while it runs.
en.settings.job.stopping: Will stop after the current stage finishes.
en.settings.job.title: Index
en.settings.lede: What this server is configured with, where each value came from, and whether the model it points at answers. Changes are written to a file on this machine.
en.settings.model.lede: One OpenAI-compatible endpoint, one chat model, one embedding model. Test before you save: the two are served independently, and an endpoint that chats will not always embed.
en.settings.model.title: Model
en.settings.saved.restart: Saved. Restart the server for these to apply: {keys}
en.settings.title: Settings
en.setup.import.body: Export your bookmarks from the browser -- Chrome, Edge and Firefox all write the same HTML file, and Chrome's JSON works too -- then hand the file over. Nothing is uploaded; it is read here and written to the library on this machine.
en.setup.import.have: The library already has pages in it. Import again any time to add more.
en.setup.import.kinds: Bookmark HTML, or Chrome's Bookmarks JSON
en.setup.import.title: Bring your bookmarks in
en.setup.index.body: This fetches each page, summarises it, and computes the vectors the four facets search over. It runs in the background and you can watch it stage by stage. A few thousand bookmarks take a while; you can stop it and pick up where it left off.
en.setup.index.have: The index is built. Run it again after importing more pages.
en.setup.index.title: Build the index
en.setup.lede: facetmark reads pages you have already saved and indexes them on this machine. Nothing leaves your computer except the text you choose to send to a model.
en.setup.model.body: Indexing asks a model to summarise each page and to turn it into a vector. Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works -- OpenAI, DeepSeek, Kimi, Zhipu, SiliconFlow, a local Ollama. Search itself runs here; the model is only used while indexing and while asking.
en.setup.model.have: A key is set. You can change it, or test that it still answers.
en.setup.model.local: Embeddings are computed locally, so no key is needed for indexing.
en.setup.model.title: Point it at a model
en.setup.ready.body: All three steps are done. This page stays here if you need it again -- it is reachable from the address bar at #/setup.
en.setup.ready.title: Ready
en.setup.title: Three steps to a working library
en.sitting.method: Grouped by {method}, allowing gaps of up to {gap}.
en.start.body: facetmark indexes why you saved a page, not only what the page says. “that thing about retries in distributed queues” works better here than a keyword.
en.start.title: Ask for it the way you remember it
en.stats.note.cold: The cold layer demotes pages you saved long ago, never opened, and that something newer appears to have replaced. It is a ranking penalty, not a deletion — facetmark never removes a bookmark.
en.stats.note.facets: Every search runs all four at once and fuses the four rankings. A result row shows a badge for each path that found it.
en.stats.note.graph: Edges between bookmarks, by the reason each one exists. The weight is what the fusion step multiplies a neighbour's score by.
en.stats.note.health: The last verdict recorded for each bookmark. Never checked is a band of its own, not an assumption that the page is fine.
en.stats.note.library: Counted from the bookmark table itself. Pages skipped for privacy are stored but never fetched or indexed.
en.stats.note.queue: Pages the server could not fetch by itself are handed to the browser extension, which opens them in a background tab using your own session.
en.stats.note.text: Only pages with stored text can be matched on their contents. The rest are matched on title, folder and URL alone.
en.stats.note.vectors: Embeddings, once a model is configured. The intent index keeps one vector per remembered query, so its denominator is the number of queries kept, not the number of pages.
en.sugg.foot: Matched against the titles, folders and URLs stored on this machine. Suggestions never leave it.
en.sugg.label: Suggestions
en.sys.check.confirm: This reaches out to other people's servers
en.sys.check.confirm.body: The check makes up to {n} real HTTP requests from this machine to the sites your bookmarks point at. Nothing is deleted either way.
en.sys.grave.none: Nothing here. Either every page that was checked answered, or nothing has been checked yet.
en.sys.grave.why: Bookmarks whose pages stopped answering. They stay in the library and stay searchable — facetmark never deletes a bookmark.
en.sys.links.why: The last verdict recorded for each bookmark. Checking reaches out to other people's servers, so it only happens when you ask for it.
en.sys.queue.why: Read-only here. Leasing an item and never completing it would stall the queue, so this page takes no work off it.
en.system.lede: What the server is doing, what it still owes the index, and which saved pages have stopped answering.
en.system.title: System

zh.ask.basis.title: 仅凭标题
zh.ask.basis.title.why: 这个页面从未抓取过，摘要是从标题推断的。
zh.ask.degraded.why: 模型要么调用失败，要么返回的内容无法解析成带引用的结论。下面的内容是从每个来源里各抽出的一句原文，不是模型写的回答。
zh.ask.gaps.why: 由检索阶段自己报告，原样呈现。
zh.ask.label: 问题
zh.ask.lede: 先检索与问题相关的页面，再让配置好的模型只依据这些页面的正文写出结论。每条结论都附带来源，方便你逐条核对。
zh.ask.mock.body: 服务器现在用的是 mock provider，所以这里返回的是占位文本，不是真正的回答。配置好对话模型后重启即可。按钮仍然可以点 —— 让你看到 mock 输出长什么样。
zh.ask.mock.title: 尚未配置模型
zh.ask.none.body: 检索阶段没有找到可供阅读的页面。可以换个说法，或者先把更多书签索引进来。
zh.ask.placeholder: 想从你存下的内容里问出什么？
zh.ask.sources.lede: 结论就是依据下面这些页面写出来的。摘录取自已存的索引，而不是重新抓取的内容。
zh.ask.title: 向书签库提问
zh.detail.basis.title: 摘要由标题推断
zh.detail.basis.title.why: 页面正文从未抓取，这条摘要来自模型对标题和网址的推断，不是从页面读到的内容。运行带抓取的 facetmark index 可以替换为真实摘要。
zh.detail.sittings.lede: 下面这些页面与这一页在同一次浏览中保存。
zh.detail.sittings.none: 这一页没有被归入任何一次浏览批次。
zh.edge.anchor_sibling.why: 与上面某条结果由同一个页面链出。
zh.edge.same_domain.why: 与上面某条结果来自同一站点。
zh.edge.semantic.why: 与上面某条结果语义相近。
zh.edge.session.why: 与上面某条结果在同一次浏览中保存。
zh.edge.supersession.why: 看起来是上面某条结果的更新版本。
zh.empty.body: 试试少写几个词，或者描述你当初想用它来做什么，而不是它叫什么。
zh.empty.import.body: facetmark 还没有任何书签。先从浏览器导入，然后建立索引。
zh.empty.import.title: 书签库是空的
zh.empty.index.body: 已经存了 {n} 个书签，但一个都还没索引，搜索没有可排序的内容。没有配置模型时这一步完全离线运行。
zh.empty.index.title: 还没有建立索引
zh.empty.queue: 还有 {n} 个页面在等待抓取，它们的正文暂时搜不到。
zh.empty.title: 书签库里还没有匹配的内容
zh.err.generic.title: 请求失败
zh.err.offline.body: 这个页面本身就是 facetmark 提供的，所以你能看到它，说明服务刚才还在运行。它可能被停掉或正在重启。
zh.err.offline.title: facetmark 服务没有响应
zh.err.token.body: 本机打开的页面，facetmark 会自动把令牌交给它。这次没有成功 —— 通常是因为你通过代理或域名访问，而不是 127.0.0.1。把令牌打印出来粘贴到这里即可。
zh.err.token.title: 这个页面需要配对令牌
zh.facet.intent.why: 该页面当初被保存时想回答的问题与查询匹配。
zh.facet.lex_seg.why: 标题、文件夹或网址中的完整词匹配。
zh.facet.lex_tri.why: 词的一部分匹配，因此不完整的词和中文查询也能命中。
zh.hit.mix: 这条结果是怎么被找到的：{parts}
zh.library.lede: facetmark 实际索引到的内容。搜索没有结果时，原因通常就在这一页。
zh.library.title: 你的书签库
zh.mark.cold.why: 很久以前保存、从未打开，而且看起来已被更新的页面取代。只会降低排序，不会删除。
zh.mark.linked.why: 通过链接关系从上面的某条结果找到。
zh.mode.A.why: 只用页面正文的向量，不用其他任何信号。
zh.mode.B: B · 内容向量 + 词面
zh.mode.B.why: 内容向量，再加上两路按字面匹配的词面 facet。这不是「只看词面」—— 梯子里没有只看词面的档。
zh.mode.C: C · 四路 facet 全开
zh.mode.C.why: 内容、提问式意图、两路词面，四路融合。
zh.mode.D.why: 在 C 的基础上，再加上一遍阅读上下文和一次链接图谱游走。更慢，且需要配置好模型才值得用。
zh.mode.E.why: 在 D 的基础上，再用重排序器把融合后的列表重排一遍。最慢的一档；没有配置模型时会退回到一个轻量的离线打分器。
zh.mode.full.why: 调用 /search 时不指定档位就是这一档：内容向量，加上链接图与时间衰减。
zh.mode.label: 检索档位
zh.opts.expand.why: 排序完成后，额外拉进最多这么多条与结果同批保存的页面。设为 0 即关闭。
zh.related.none: 还没有任何页面与它相连。链接图是在索引时建立的。
zh.results.window_capped: 第 {from}–{to} 条，共 {total}+ 条 · 已达深度上限
zh.search.label: 搜索你的书签库
zh.search.title: 搜索你的书签库
zh.sessions.lede: 在时间上挨得很近的书签会被归成一批 —— 分组依据是相邻保存之间的间隔。两个页面为什么属于一起，往往只有当时的阅读顺序还记得。
zh.sessions.none.body: 批次是在索引时依据书签的保存时间划分的。可以把门槛调低，或者先索引书签库。
zh.sessions.title: 浏览批次
zh.settings.file.body: 保存会写这个文件，权限只对你自己开放。已导出的环境变量仍然压过文件里的一切，上面有些框是只读的就是这个原因。
zh.settings.file.title: 写到哪儿
zh.settings.h.api_key: 保存在本机。界面上只显示头尾几个字符。
zh.settings.h.base_url: 接口地址，通常以 /v1 结尾。可以指向服务商，也可以指向本机服务。
zh.settings.h.chat_model: 建索引时用它写网页摘要，综述时用它写答案。
zh.settings.h.chat_model_fallbacks: 主模型拒绝时按顺序尝试。用逗号分隔。
zh.settings.h.embed_backend: api 走上面那个接口；local 在本机跑模型，不需要 Key。
zh.settings.h.embed_dim: 必须和模型对得上。改了它，已存的向量全部作废。
zh.settings.h.embed_model: 把网页文字变成向量，四路检索里有两路搜的就是它。
zh.settings.h.enrich_concurrency: 同时进行多少条摘要。服务商都有限流，这是那个旋钮。
zh.settings.h.fetch_concurrency: 调高更快，但对被访问的站点更不客气。开始大量失败就调低。
zh.settings.h.local_embed_path: 本地向量模型在磁盘上的位置。
zh.settings.h.privacy_excluded_domains: 既不抓取也不发给模型。用逗号分隔。网银和邮箱应该写在这里。
zh.settings.h.request_timeout: 一次模型调用等多少秒就放弃。
zh.settings.job.cancelled: 已停止。再跑一次会从这里接着来。
zh.settings.job.lede: 七个阶段，按顺序走。抓取和写摘要是慢的两步。跑着的时候你可以离开这一页。
zh.settings.job.stopping: 将在当前阶段结束后停止。
zh.settings.job.title: 索引任务
zh.settings.lede: 这台服务当前用的是什么配置、每个值是从哪儿来的、它指的模型答不答。改动会写进本机的一个文件。
zh.settings.model.lede: 一个 OpenAI 兼容的接口地址、一个对话模型、一个向量模型。保存前先测一下：这两类是分开提供的，能对话的接口不一定能出向量。
zh.settings.model.title: 模型
zh.settings.saved: 已保存。{n} 项立即生效。
zh.settings.saved.restart: 已保存。这些要重启服务才生效：{keys}
zh.settings.title: 设置
zh.setup.import.body: 先从浏览器导出书签——Chrome、Edge、Firefox 导出的都是同一种 HTML 文件，Chrome 的 JSON 也可以——然后把文件交给这里。文件不会上传，它在本机被读取并写进本机的书签库。
zh.setup.import.have: 库里已经有书签了。随时可以再导一次，把新的加进来。
zh.setup.import.kinds: 书签 HTML，或 Chrome 的 Bookmarks JSON
zh.setup.import.ok: 新增 {inserted} 条，更新 {updated} 条，跳过 {skipped} 条。
zh.setup.import.title: 把书签导进来
zh.setup.index.body: 这一步会抓取每个网页、写摘要、并算出四路检索要用的向量。它在后台跑，你可以一个阶段一个阶段地看。几千条书签要跑一阵子；中途可以停，下次接着上次的进度继续。
zh.setup.index.have: 索引已经建好了。以后再导入新书签，重跑一次即可。
zh.setup.index.title: 建索引
zh.setup.lede: facetmark 读取你已经收藏的网页，并在这台机器上为它们建索引。除了你主动交给模型的那段文字，没有任何内容离开你的电脑。
zh.setup.model.body: 建索引时要请模型给每个网页写摘要、并把它变成向量。任何 OpenAI 兼容的接口都行——OpenAI、DeepSeek、Kimi、智谱、SiliconFlow，或者本机跑的 Ollama。检索本身完全在本机进行，模型只在建索引和写综述时用到。
zh.setup.model.have: 已经配了 Key。你可以改，也可以测一下它还答不答。
zh.setup.model.local: 向量在本机计算，建索引不需要 Key。
zh.setup.model.title: 指一个模型给它用
zh.setup.ready.body: 三步都完成了。这一页会留在这儿，需要时从地址栏 #/setup 就能回来。
zh.setup.ready.title: 都齐了
zh.setup.title: 三步搭好你的书签库
zh.sitting.method: 按 {method} 分组，允许的最大间隔为 {gap}。
zh.start.body: facetmark 索引的是你当初为什么存这个页面，而不只是页面写了什么。「那篇讲分布式队列重试的东西」在这里比一个关键词更管用。
zh.start.title: 按你记得的样子去问
zh.stats.health.total: {total} 个书签中有 {n} 个有判定结果
zh.stats.note.cold: 冷却层会降低那些你很久以前存下、从未打开、而且看起来已被更新内容取代的页面的排名。这只是排序惩罚，不是删除 —— facetmark 永远不会删掉一个书签。
zh.stats.note.facets: 每次搜索四条路同时跑，再把四份排名融合起来。结果行上的徽章表示这条结果是被哪几条路找到的。
zh.stats.note.graph: 书签之间的边，按建立原因分类。权重就是融合阶段用来乘以邻居分数的系数。
zh.stats.note.health: 每个书签最近一次的判定。「从未检查」自成一档，不默认它没问题。
zh.stats.note.library: 直接来自书签表的计数。因隐私跳过的页面会被保存，但从不抓取、也不索引。
zh.stats.note.queue: 服务端自己抓不下来的页面会交给浏览器扩展，由它用你自己的登录状态在后台标签页里打开。
zh.stats.note.text: 只有存下正文的页面才能按内容匹配，其余的只能靠标题、文件夹和网址来匹配。
zh.stats.note.vectors: 配置了模型之后生成的向量。意图索引为每一条记住的提问式查询各存一个向量，所以它的分母是保留的查询数，而不是页面数。
zh.sugg.foot: 只在本机已存的标题、文件夹和网址里做匹配。联想内容不会离开这台机器。
zh.sugg.label: 查询联想
zh.sys.check.confirm: 这会向第三方站点发起真实请求
zh.sys.check.confirm.body: 这次检查会从本机向书签指向的站点发起最多 {n} 个真实的 HTTP 请求。无论结果如何都不会删除任何东西。
zh.sys.grave.none: 这里是空的。要么每个检查过的页面都还能访问，要么还没有检查过。
zh.sys.grave.why: 这些书签指向的页面已经不再响应。它们仍然留在书签库里、仍然可以被搜到 —— facetmark 从不删除书签。
zh.sys.links.why: 每个书签最近一次的判定结果。检查会向第三方站点发起请求，所以只在你主动要求时才会跑。
zh.sys.queue.why: 这里只读。领走一条却不完成会把队列卡住，所以这个页面从不从队列里取任务。
zh.system.lede: 服务器当前的状态、索引还欠着哪些活，以及哪些存下的页面已经不再响应。
zh.system.title: 系统
